// protocol.ts + protocol-api.ts of calvin (work 084) at calvin#138 b9de827
// Contracts between the three processes of the split deployment (work 045):
//
//   gateway  (bluecode's Worker in production, src/gateway on a laptop)  Slack HTTP, routing, tables, secrets
//     ⇅  one WebSocket per host, dialed by the host: GatewayToHost / HostToGateway
//   host agent (VM or laptop)           forks, runner lifecycle, housekeeping
//     ⇅  one unix socket per runner, the runner listens: HostToRunner / RunnerToHost
//   runner   (one per active session)    Agent SDK query(), renders to Slack itself
//
// Every message is one JSON object per WebSocket frame or per line on a unix
// socket. Messages that expect an answer carry an `id`; the answer is a
// `reply` (or `token`) with the same id. Unknown `t` values are ignored, so
// either side can be newer (risk R4).
//
// Changing this file changes the contract for every work item; coordinate in
// work 045 before editing it.

import type { Tier } from './tiers.js';
import type { Linked } from './links.js';
import type { Batch } from './telemetry/emitter.js';
import type { ApiDelivery, GatewayToHostV4, HostToGatewayV4, HostToRunnerV4, JournalReport, RunnerApi, WireConfig } from './protocol-api.js';

export * from './protocol-api.js';

// 2 (work 077): the hello carries `features`; `deliver.model`, `model`, `probe`/`probed`,
// `model-bound`/`model-health`/`model-denied`. The gateway routes a host below 2 managed only.
// 3 (work 082): subscription routes carry `provider` and `accountId`, sessions a `harness`,
// `model-health` a `provider`, `probe` a `provider` and `accountId`; the hello's `features` add
// `model-proxy/chatgpt`. Every field is optional and absent means what it meant at 2 (anthropic,
// claude), so a v2 frame reads unchanged; the gateway sends chatgpt routes only to a host that
// says 3 and lists `model-proxy/chatgpt`.
// 4 (work 084): the streaming session API (protocol-api.ts); a session may have no Slack thread and
// carries its `cs_` id; a person may have no Slack id. All optional: a v3 frame reads unchanged, and
// the gateway sends v4 frames only to a host that says 4.
export const PROTOCOL_VERSION = 4;

/** Whose subscription a route spends (work 082). Absent wherever it is optional: anthropic. */
export type ModelProvider = 'anthropic' | 'chatgpt';

/** Which agent runs a session's turns (work 082). Absent: claude. */
export type HarnessName = 'claude' | 'codex';

/**
 * A session's permission mode as persisted and sent between processes: Claude
 * Code's names, kept for every harness (work 082; a harness maps its own).
 * harness/claude/ asserts they still equal the SDK's.
 */
export type PermissionMode = 'default' | 'acceptEdits' | 'bypassPermissions' | 'plan' | 'dontAsk' | 'auto';
/** A reasoning effort, as `!effort` sets it and a session persists it; each harness's `caps.effort` says which it takes (`ultra`: Codex only). */
export type EffortLevel = 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | 'xhigh' | 'max' | 'ultra';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- shared shapes

/** A Slack file as the event carries it; the runner downloads it with the bot token. */
export interface SlackFile {
  id: string;
  name?: string;
  mimetype?: string;
  size?: number;
  url_private?: string;
  url_private_download?: string;
}

/** A row of the gateway's people table: who may use the instance. */
export interface Person {
  /** Work 084: absent for a person with no Slack identity (an `opc` user); `userId` is then set. */
  slackUserId?: string;
  /** Work 084: the member, `usr_…`: the API's `Person.id`, the wire's `member`; `name`/`email` for the API. */
  userId?: string;
  name?: string;
  email?: string;
  /** Directory name on the host: /data/people/<dir> (046). Work 084: `user-<id>` for a person with no Slack id. */
  dir: string;
  /** Git author for commits made in this person's sessions. */
  gitName: string;
  gitEmail: string;
  /** May set and remove workspace-wide secrets (work 046). */
  admin?: boolean;
}

/** Everything a host needs to start or resume a session's runner. */
export interface SessionSpec {
  /** `<channel>:<threadTs>` for threads, `<channel>` for code channels; work 084: the `cs_` id for a session with no Slack thread. Internal: never on the API. */
  key: string;
  /** Work 084: `api` for a session with no Slack binding (created over the API). */
  kind: 'thread' | 'channel' | 'api';
  /** Work 084: absent for a session with no Slack binding; it then renders nowhere (NullSurface) and is read through the API. */
  channel?: string;
  /** Work 084: the public id, `cs_` + 16 (session-ids.ts); `origin` (`slack|opc|dashboard|api`) and `metadata` for the API. */
  sessionId?: string;
  origin?: { type: string; client?: string };
  metadata?: Record<string, string>;
  threadTs?: string;
  /** The initiator; owns the session (thesis: a thread runs as who started it). */
  owner: Person;
  teamId?: string;
  title: string;
  mode: PermissionMode;
  model?: string;
  /** Reasoning effort set with `!effort`; the default without. */
  effort?: EffortLevel;
  /** Set once the runner reported it; present means resume. */
  sdkSessionId?: string;
  /** Set once the host forked; present means the fork exists. */
  forkPath?: string;
  /** Work 082: the agent that runs its turns; absent = claude. `codex` comes only with a chatgpt subscription route. */
  harness?: HarnessName;
}

/** One Slack message delivered into a session. Text is already decoded and the mention stripped. */
export interface Delivery {
  userId: string;
  text: string;
  /** The message's own ts, for reactions. */
  ts: string;
  /** Fetched by the runner with the bot token, never by the gateway. */
  files?: SlackFile[];
  /**
   * A person's message in the conversation: whether it @mentions the bot. The
   * agent sees who wrote it and this, and may stay silent when it is not
   * addressed to it. Unset for synthetic deliveries (a spawned thread's brief).
   */
  mentioned?: boolean;
  /**
   * The bot is @mentioned only mid-message ("ask @bot to check"), not at the
   * start: maybe a request, maybe a remark about it. Older runners ignore it.
   */
  mentionedInline?: boolean;
  /**
   * Slack permalinks in the text, read by the gateway when the security model
   * allows it, else the reason (work 049). Older runners ignore it.
   */
  linked?: Linked[];
  /** Work 084: a message from the API (opc, dashboard): who, and how it is delivered when busy. */
  api?: ApiDelivery;
}

/**
 * Telemetry trace context (work 054): minted by the gateway per message and
 * carried on `deliver`; the host adds its stamps before forwarding. Optional
 * everywhere, so older hosts and runners ignore it.
 */
export interface TraceContext {
  /** trace_id, UUIDv7. */
  id: string;
  /** ms since epoch: the frontend's own time for the message (Slack ts × 1000). */
  sentAt: number;
  /** Gateway wall clock at message.received. */
  receivedAt: number;
  /** Gateway wall clock at dispatch.sent. */
  dispatchedAt?: number;
  surface: string;
  surfaceWorkspaceId: string;
  conversationId: string;
  personId: string;
  surfaceEventId?: string;
  gatewayVersion?: string;
  gatewayRegion?: string;
  gatewaySessionId?: string;
  synthetic?: boolean;
  // Added by the host before forwarding to the runner. (Hosts before calvin#49
  // also sent hostReceivedAt, runnerReadyAt, forkMs and launchMs; ignored now:
  // those are host events on the same trace, joined in SQL.)
  path?: 'warm' | 'new' | 'resume' | 'prewarmed';
}

export type SessionStatus = 'starting' | 'idle' | 'busy' | 'stopped' | 'error';

/** What a host reports about a session; the gateway stores it in the session table. */
export interface SessionReport {
  key: string;
  /** Work 084: the `cs_` id, when the session has one. */
  sessionId?: string;
  status: SessionStatus;
  sdkSessionId?: string;
  forkPath?: string;
  runnerVersion?: string;
  model?: string;
  effort?: EffortLevel;
  mode?: PermissionMode;
  error?: string;
  /** Work 082: the harness the runner runs; absent = claude (so a Claude runner's report is unchanged). */
  harness?: HarnessName;
  subagents?: number; // work 084: running subagents (absent = 0); the host never idle-exits a runner with any
}

export interface WorkspaceStatus {
  person: string;
  repos: { name: string; fetchedAt?: string; head?: string; problem?: string }[];
}

/** Credentials the gateway hands to a host at connect; held in memory only. */
export interface HostCredentials {
  slackBotToken: string;
  slackBotUserId: string;
  teamId?: string;
  /** Exactly one of these. */
  claudeOAuthToken?: string;
  anthropicApiKey?: string;
  /**
   * With anthropicApiKey: an Anthropic-compatible endpoint the key belongs to
   * (work 052: the organization's metered model key, https://openrouter.ai/api).
   * The runner sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and passes the key as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN.
   */
  anthropicBaseUrl?: string;
  /** Work 077: the session runs on its owner's subscription through the proxy; set only with no Claude fields. */
  claudeSubscription?: ClaudeSubscription;
}

/**
 * Which model credential a session runs on (work 077). `subscription`: its
 * owner's Claude Pro/Max seat, or (work 082, `provider: 'chatgpt'`) their
 * ChatGPT plan, through the VM's oc-modelproxy; the token goes to the proxy
 * only, never to a runner. A chatgpt route's `fingerprint` names the owner
 * and account, not the token (credential-fingerprint.ts), so a refreshed
 * token is the same credential and the proxy swaps it in place.
 * `managed`: the delivery's (or the welcome's) `credentials`, as before 077.
 * `refuse`: only on `model` pushes.
 */
export type ModelRoute =
  | {
      mode: 'subscription';
      /** Absent: anthropic. */
      provider?: ModelProvider;
      owner: string;
      token: string;
      fingerprint: string;
      /** chatgpt: required (the proxy sends it upstream as `chatgpt-account-id`). */
      accountId?: string;
      maxModel?: string;
    }
  | { mode: 'managed' }
  | { mode: 'refuse'; reason: string };

/** A subscription's usage windows, as Anthropic's rate-limit headers and /api/oauth/usage give them. */
export interface ModelUsage {
  fiveHourPct?: number;
  fiveHourReset?: number;
  sevenDayPct?: number;
  sevenDayReset?: number;
}

/** What a runner on a subscription knows of it: never the token. */
export interface ClaudeSubscription {
  owner: string;
  fingerprint: string;
  maxModel?: string;
  /** Work 082: whose subscription the fingerprint is (absent: anthropic). The field keeps its v2 name for wire compatibility. */
  provider?: ModelProvider;
}

/** A session asks for a new thread to run work in parallel (work 047). */
export interface SpawnRequest {
  /** One line: what the new thread should do. */
  task: string;
  /** Workspace-relative path of the Markdown brief (optional #anchor), already on its repository's default branch. */
  brief: string;
  /** The brief on GitHub, for the posted message. */
  briefUrl?: string;
  /** Model tier for the new thread (`smart`, `fast`, `default`); without one it keeps the parent's model. */
  tier?: Tier;
}

export interface SpawnResult {
  key: string;
  url?: string;
}

/**
 * Preview URLs (work 074): the host runs `cloudflared tunnel run` with
 * `tunnelToken` in TUNNEL_TOKEN, and its preview proxy (host/preview-proxy.ts)
 * forwards only `ports`, only requests signed with `key` (base64url, 32 bytes;
 * src/signed-header.ts). Held in memory only, like credentials.
 */
export interface PreviewConfig {
  tunnelToken: string;
  key: string;
  ports: number[];
}

/** A session asks for a public URL to one of its ports (the `preview` tool). */
export interface PreviewRequest {
  port: number;
  /** A chosen name (one DNS label); without one the gateway generates one, or returns the port's existing name. */
  name?: string;
}

/** The gateway's answer; `unpreview` answers with `{ url: "", name, port: 0 }`. */
export interface PreviewResult {
  url: string;
  name: string;
  port: number;
}

/** What the host gives the runner: the gateway's answer and its readiness probe (host/preview-probe.ts). */
export interface PreviewToolResult extends PreviewResult {
  /** The port answered HTTP within the probe's wait. */
  listening: boolean;
  /** The one config line a framework's host check needs, when the probe met it. */
  hint?: string;
}

/** A Slack thread a session reads or posts to (work 049 L3): a permalink, or a channel id and a message ts. */
export interface ReadThreadRequest {
  url?: string;
  channel?: string;
  ts?: string;
}

export interface PostThreadRequest extends ReadThreadRequest {
  /** Slack mrkdwn; the gateway neutralizes channel-wide mentions and appends who it was posted for. */
  text: string;
}

export interface PostThreadResult {
  ts: string;
  url: string;
}

/** Where a secret applies (work 046): one session, every session of a person, or every session. */
export type SecretScope = 'session' | 'user' | 'workspace';

/** A secret a session gets: an environment variable, or a file whose path is in the variable. */
export interface SessionSecret {
  name: string;
  value: string;
  scope: SecretScope;
  file?: boolean;
  /** A variable (`!var`): not secret, so never redacted. Older runners redact it like a secret. */
  variable?: boolean;
}

/** A session asks its person for a secret (the request_secret tool); the gateway posts a button. */
export interface SecretRequest {
  name: string;
  /** One line: what it is for, shown with the button. */
  reason: string;
  file?: boolean;
}

/** One repository of a workspace definition. */
export interface WorkspaceRepo {
  /** Directory name in the workspace. */
  name: string;
  /** HTTPS clone URL, no credentials. */
  remote: string;
  /** Default branch; otherwise origin/HEAD. */
  branch?: string;
  /** Shell commands run once in the clone after cloning. */
  setup?: string[];
  /** Listed but not cloned (the remote doesn't exist yet). */
  unpublished?: boolean;
  /**
   * `eager` (the default): cloned in the background when the workspace is
   * prepared and kept fetched. `lazy`: cloned (partially, blobs on demand) only
   * when a session checks it out. No session ever waits on an eager clone.
   */
  clone?: 'eager' | 'lazy';
  /** For the repository index in a fork's AGENTS.md: GitHub's description, main language, last push (ISO). */
  description?: string;
  language?: string;
  pushedAt?: string;
}

/**
 * A workspace definition: the shape of definitions/opencomputer.json. On disk
 * (SP_DEFINITION) rootFiles sources are relative to the file; from the gateway
 * they are relative to the release's definitions/ directory.
 */
export interface WorkspaceDefinition {
  name?: string;
  about?: string;
  repos: WorkspaceRepo[];
  /** Target path in the workspace root → source file. */
  rootFiles?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface GitHubToken {
  token: string;
  /** ISO time. */
  expiresAt: string;
  /** An OpenComputer key's API URL (kind 'opencomputer', work 067). */
  apiUrl?: string;
  /** The automations repository's git remote, without credentials, and its basic-auth user (kind 'automation-repo'). */
  remoteUrl?: string;
  username?: string;
}

/**
 * What a token is for: GitHub (git, gh), the OpenComputer CLI (a one-hour org
 * key), or pushing to the organization's automations repository (work 067).
 */
export type TokenKind = 'github' | 'opencomputer' | 'automation-repo';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- gateway ⇄ host

/** Sent by the host. The host authenticates with `Authorization: Bearer <host token>` on the upgrade. */
export type HostToGateway =
  /**
   * `features`: `model-proxy` once this host runs as sp-host with oc-modelproxy's control socket up (work 077);
   * `model-proxy/chatgpt` too when that proxy's own hello lists `chatgpt` among its providers (work 082).
   */
  | { t: 'hello'; protocol: number; hostId: string; version: string; sessions: SessionReport[]; features?: string[]; journals?: JournalReport[] }
  | { t: 'session'; report: SessionReport }
  | { t: 'workspace'; status: WorkspaceStatus }
  /**
   * The data volume's size and free space (work 071), every 5 minutes:
   * a managed gateway grows the disk when it nears capacity. Older gateways ignore it.
   */
  | { t: 'disk'; totalBytes: number; freeBytes: number }
  /** A GitHub token for git/gh inside a session (credential helper → host → gateway). */
  | { t: 'token'; id: string; sessionKey?: string; repos?: string[]; kind?: TokenKind }
  /** Session `from` starts a new thread (work 047); answered by `spawned`. */
  | { t: 'spawn'; id: string; from: string; req: SpawnRequest }
  /** Session `from` asks its person for a secret; answered by `secret-asked`. */
  | { t: 'secret-request'; id: string; from: string; req: SecretRequest }
  /** Session `from` reads a Slack thread (work 049 L3); answered by `thread`, a refusal being a `Linked` that is not ok. */
  | { t: 'read'; id: string; from: string; req: ReadThreadRequest }
  /** Session `from` posts into a Slack thread for its owner; answered by `posted`. */
  | { t: 'post'; id: string; from: string; req: PostThreadRequest }
  /** Session `from` registers a port's public URL, or releases a name (work 074); both answered by `previewed`. */
  | { t: 'preview'; id: string; from: string; req: PreviewRequest }
  | { t: 'unpreview'; id: string; from: string; req: { name: string } }
  /** The model provider refused session `sessionKey`'s turn for credits (a 402): the gateway tells the thread how to get more. */
  | { t: 'out-of-credits'; sessionKey: string }
  /** Work 077: answers `probe`. `error` is a class only ('timeout' | 'proxy_unavailable' | 'error'), never an error's text. */
  | { t: 'probed'; id: string; result?: { status: number; usage?: ModelUsage }; error?: string }
  /** A session's route took effect at the proxy (subscription, refuse) or at a runner start (managed). */
  | { t: 'model-bound'; sessionKey: string; mode: ModelRoute['mode']; fingerprint?: string }
  /** A subscription's health, on change and at most once a minute otherwise; `unauthorized` is one upstream 401. */
  /** Work 082: `provider` is whose upstream answered (absent: anthropic); a chatgpt `unauthorized` asks the gateway for a refreshed token. */
  | { t: 'model-health'; sessionKey: string; fingerprint: string; provider?: ModelProvider; status: 'ok' | 'limited' | 'unauthorized' | 'error';
      limitedUntil?: number; errorClass?: string; usage?: ModelUsage }
  /** The seat refused `model`; the session now runs on `fallbackTo`. */
  | { t: 'model-denied'; sessionKey: string; model: string; fallbackTo: string }
  | { t: 'reply'; id: string; ok: boolean; error?: string }
  | HostToGatewayV4;

export type GatewayToHost =
  /**
   * `definition` (work 052): the organization's workspace definition, used instead of
   * SP_DEFINITION and kept on disk until a later welcome changes it. Absent: no change.
   */
  /** `telemetryCredential` (work 054): a renewed signed credential for the telemetry collector. Absent: keep the current one. */
  | {
      t: 'welcome';
      protocol: number;
      credentials: HostCredentials;
      people: Person[];
      definition?: WorkspaceDefinition;
      telemetryCredential?: string;
      /** The collector base URL, for a host whose host.env has no SP_TELEMETRY_URL. Ignored when it has one. */
      telemetryUrl?: string;
      /** Work 074: this computer's previews. Absent: its tunnel is not provisioned yet; cloudflared stays stopped. */
      preview?: PreviewConfig;
      /** Work 084: the relay's edge key. Absent: the wire is off on this computer (the relay refuses every upgrade). */
      wire?: WireConfig;
    }
  /** Work 074: the previews config changed (tunnel provisioned, a port registered or released); sent before the `previewed` it causes. */
  | { t: 'previews'; preview: PreviewConfig }
  | { t: 'people'; people: Person[] }
  /**
   * A warm-pool host (id `pool-…`) was claimed by an organization (work 052):
   * keep this identity and reconnect as it. Refused by any other host.
   */
  | { t: 'assign'; organizationId: string; hostToken: string; gatewayUrl: string }
  /** Credentials changed (fresh Slack install, new Claude token): replaces the welcome's; the host forwards to runners. */
  | { t: 'credentials'; credentials: HostCredentials }
  /** Start the runner if needed (fork if no forkPath, resume if sdkSessionId), then deliver. */
  /** Per-delivery credentials let a multi-tenant gateway keep workspace tokens scoped to one session. */
  /** `model` (work 077): the session's route; absent means managed (gateways before 077). */
  /** Work 084: `epoch` and `lastSeq` seed the session's journal as on `start` (absent: 1 and 0, or the local journal's). */
  | { t: 'deliver'; id: string; session: SessionSpec; msg: Delivery; credentials?: HostCredentials; secrets?: SessionSecret[]; trace?: TraceContext;
      model?: ModelRoute; epoch?: number; lastSeq?: number }
  /** Work 077: a session's route changed (pause, limit, revoke, policy); applied by the proxy or at the runner's next start. */
  | { t: 'model'; sessionKey: string; model: ModelRoute }
  /**
   * Work 077: validate a Claude token (GET /api/oauth/usage through the proxy); answered by `probed`.
   * Work 082: `provider`/`accountId` for a ChatGPT token (absent: anthropic).
   */
  | { t: 'probe'; id: string; token: string; provider?: ModelProvider; accountId?: string }
  /** A session's secrets changed: the host passes them to its runner, if one is running. */
  | { t: 'secrets'; sessionKey: string; secrets: SessionSecret[] }
  /** A button click on a prompt the session's runner posted. */
  | { t: 'action'; id: string; sessionKey: string; promptId: string; value: string; userId: string }
  /** Slack's stop button or !stop: interrupt the running turn. */
  | { t: 'stop'; id: string; sessionKey: string }
  /** A push to a repository: fetch it in every workspace that has it (D4). */
  | { t: 'pushed'; repo: string; ref: string }
  | { t: 'token'; id: string; result?: GitHubToken; error?: string }
  | { t: 'spawned'; id: string; result?: SpawnResult; error?: string }
  | { t: 'thread'; id: string; result?: Linked; error?: string }
  | { t: 'posted'; id: string; result?: PostThreadResult; error?: string }
  /** Answers `preview` and `unpreview`; `error` is a sentence for the model. */
  | { t: 'previewed'; id: string; result?: PreviewResult; error?: string }
  | { t: 'secret-asked'; id: string; error?: string }
  | { t: 'reply'; id: string; ok: boolean; error?: string }
  | GatewayToHostV4;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- host ⇄ runner

/** The runner's start-up input: JSON in the RUNNER_SPEC environment variable. */
export interface RunnerSpec {
  /**
   * The runner's own id (work 069), minted by the host: names its socket, unit
   * and secrets directory for its life. Absent from hosts before 069, whose
   * runners are named by their session key.
   */
  id?: string;
  /** The session; absent for a spare, which gets it with `claim`. */
  session?: SessionSpec & { forkPath: string };
  /** Unix socket path the runner listens on. */
  socket: string;
  /** Work 084: the runner is the session's API writer (protocol-api.ts). */
  api?: RunnerApi;
  /** Code version (git commit) the runner was started from. */
  version: string;
}

/** A spare runner's state (work 069): a parked Claude Code waiting for a session. */
export interface SpareReport {
  id: string;
  /** Parked and claimable; false while (re)starting its Claude Code. */
  ready: boolean;
  version: string;
  /** Fingerprint of the Claude credential it was started with (credential-fingerprint.ts). */
  credential?: string;
}

export type HostToRunner =
  | { t: 'deliver'; id: string; msg: Delivery; trace?: TraceContext }
  | { t: 'action'; id: string; promptId: string; value: string; userId: string }
  | { t: 'stop'; id: string }
  /** Credentials refreshed (e.g. after a host reconnect). */
  | { t: 'credentials'; credentials: HostCredentials }
  /** Exit when no turn is running (idle timeout, code update, drain); `ms`: quit after it anyway (a retired runner, work 084). */
  | { t: 'exit'; ms?: number }
  | { t: 'token'; id: string; result?: GitHubToken; error?: string }
  | { t: 'spawned'; id: string; result?: SpawnResult; error?: string }
  | { t: 'thread'; id: string; result?: Linked; error?: string }
  | { t: 'posted'; id: string; result?: PostThreadResult; error?: string }
  | { t: 'previewed'; id: string; result?: PreviewToolResult; error?: string }
  /** The session's secrets, all of them: sent before a delivery and whenever they change. */
  | { t: 'secrets'; secrets: SessionSecret[] }
  | { t: 'secret-asked'; id: string; error?: string }
  | { t: 'checked-out'; id: string; result?: CheckoutResult[]; error?: string }
  /**
   * A spare becomes this session's runner (work 069): its fork is complete.
   * Answered by `reply`; on an error the host starts the session cold.
   */
  | { t: 'claim'; id: string; session: SessionSpec & { forkPath: string }; api?: RunnerApi }
  /** The session's owner changed (their name or email became known): commits from now on carry it. */
  | { t: 'owner'; owner: Person } | HostToRunnerV4;

/** A repository checked out into a running session's fork (`checkout_repo`), cloned first if needed. */
export interface CheckoutResult {
  name: string;
  /** Fork-relative directory. */
  dir: string;
  branch: string;
  from: string;
  base: string;
  /** Set when the repository could not be checked out; the others still were. */
  error?: string;
  /** The fetch before the worktree failed; it starts from the cached default branch. */
  fetchError?: string;
}

export type RunnerToHost =
  | { t: 'report'; report: SessionReport }
  /** Sent by a runner without a session instead of `report`; never forwarded to the gateway. */
  | { t: 'spare'; spare: SpareReport }
  | { t: 'token'; id: string; repos?: string[] }
  | { t: 'spawn'; id: string; req: SpawnRequest }
  | { t: 'read'; id: string; req: ReadThreadRequest }
  | { t: 'post'; id: string; req: PostThreadRequest }
  /** Work 074: answered by `previewed`, after the host's readiness probe for `preview`. */
  | { t: 'preview'; id: string; req: PreviewRequest }
  | { t: 'unpreview'; id: string; req: { name: string } }
  | { t: 'secret-request'; id: string; req: SecretRequest }
  /** Check repositories (names or owner/name) out into this session's fork; answered by `checked-out`. */
  | { t: 'checkout'; id: string; repos: string[] }
  /** Telemetry the runner buffered (work 054); the host re-validates and ships it. */
  | { t: 'telemetry'; batch: Batch }
  /** The model provider refused this session's turn for credits; forwarded to the gateway as `out-of-credits`. */
  | { t: 'out-of-credits' }
  /** Work 077: the subscription refused `model`; the runner switched to `fallbackTo`. Forwarded as `model-denied`. */
  | { t: 'model-denied'; model: string; fallbackTo: string }
  | { t: 'reply'; id: string; ok: boolean; error?: string };

// Slack button ids: action-ids.ts (p:<base64url(sessionKey)>:<promptId>:<value>).
export { decodeActionId, encodeActionId } from './action-ids.js';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- layout on a host

/** Defaults for a host; overridable by env (SP_DATA, SP_RUN). */
export const HOST_DATA = process.env.SP_DATA ?? '/data';
export const HOST_RUN = process.env.SP_RUN ?? '/run/slack-presence';
/** Local socket where git credential helpers and the gh shim ask the host for a token. */
export const HOST_TOKEN_SOCKET = 'token.sock';
// Protocol v4's frames (work 084): the Computer's streaming session API, as the
// processes pass it to each other. protocol.ts re-exports everything here and
// splices the gateway frames into its unions; this file exists only to keep
// protocol.ts under the size ratchet, and is part of the same contract
// (blue/src/computer/protocol.ts mirrors both).
//
//   gateway ⇄ host    `start`/`started`, `api`/`api-result`, `journal`/`journal-ack`, `access`, `revoked`
//   relay   ⇄ host    WireToHost / HostToWire over $HOST_RUN/wire.sock (host/wire-link.ts)
//   relay, host ⇄ writer   ApiClientFrame / ApiWriterFrame over <runner id>.api.sock (the session's
//                     writer: its runner, or the host's session-writer when none runs)
//
// Invariants:
// - Every v4 field on a pre-v4 frame is optional; a v3 peer reads every frame it knows unchanged.
// - Bodies (`params`, `result`, `event.data`) are the public API's shapes, defined once in
//   src/api/schema.ts and published as schema/computer-api.v1.json; here they are opaque.
// - An operation is named by its WebSocket method (`turns.send`, …); its HTTP route is the same
//   operation, so one idempotency key covers both.
// - Ids: sessions `cs_…` (src/session-ids.ts); members are `usr_…` (Person.userId).

import type { HostCredentials, ModelRoute, Person, SessionSecret, SessionSpec } from './protocol.js';

/** Who acted, as every event and write carries it (API `Actor`). */
export interface ApiActor {
  /** `usr_…` for a person; a key's or the system's id otherwise. */
  id: string;
  name: string | null;
  /** `slack` | `opc` | `dashboard` | `api` | `system`; open. */
  via: string;
  /** The client and version, e.g. `opc/0.1.0`; null when unknown. */
  client: string | null;
}

/** An API error body: `code` is one of errors.mdx's codes (open), `status` its HTTP status. */
export interface ApiError {
  code: string;
  message: string;
  status: number;
  retryable?: boolean;
  /** Code-specific fields (`retryAfterMs`, `ask`, `session`, `field`, `reason`, …). */
  [field: string]: unknown;
}

/** One journal event in the public envelope (API `Event`); `data` per its `type`. */
export interface JournalEvent {
  /** `ev_…`, unique per session. */
  id: string;
  seq: number;
  /** ISO time. */
  createdAt: string;
  sessionId: string;
  turnId: string | null;
  type: string;
  actor: ApiActor | null;
  data: unknown;
}

/** A transient delta (API `Delta`): never journaled, never replayed after its record completes. */
export interface JournalDelta {
  type: string;
  sessionId: string;
  turnId: string | null;
  data: unknown;
}

/** Who may attach to a session (pushed by the gateway, forwarded to the relay). */
export interface SessionAccess {
  sessionId: string;
  /** `usr_…` of the owner; may always attach and open terminals. */
  owner: string;
  /** Others who may attach (read and write); null: every member of the organization. */
  members: string[] | null;
  /**
   * The organization's admins (`usr_…`), who may also open terminals in this session (attaching still follows
   * `members`). Absent: only the host's own list (the welcome's `people[].admin`) counts.
   */
  admins?: string[];
}

/** API session status (API `Session.status`). */
export type ApiSessionStatus = 'starting' | 'running' | 'waiting' | 'idle' | 'suspended';

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- gateway ⇄ host (v4)

/** Spliced into GatewayToHost. */
export type GatewayToHostV4 =
  /**
   * Claim a spare and fork for `session` with no input (a session created over the API); answered by
   * `started`. `epoch` and `lastSeq` seed the writer's journal (seq continues at max(local, lastSeq) + 1).
   */
  | { t: 'start'; id: string; session: SessionSpec; epoch: number; lastSeq: number;
      credentials?: HostCredentials; secrets?: SessionSecret[];
      model?: ModelRoute }
  /**
   * An API write or read for session `sessionId`, from an HTTP route: `method` is the WebSocket method of the same
   * operation, `params` its params. The host hands it to the session's writer; answered by `api-result` (15 s at the gateway).
   */
  | { t: 'api'; id: string; sessionId: string; method: string; params: unknown; actor: ApiActor;
      /** `usr_…` of the caller (the idempotency scope). */
      member: string; idempotencyKey?: string; requestId?: string;
      /** The session, when the host may not know it yet (a write to a session with no runner and no local journal). */
      session?: SessionSpec; epoch?: number; lastSeq?: number }
  /**
   * The SessionLog stored every event of `epoch` up to `seq`: the host may drop them from its spool. On a gap the DO
   * acks nothing and closes the socket with 4010 ("journal gap"); the host resends everything unacked after it reconnects.
   */
  | { t: 'journal-ack'; sessionId: string; epoch: number; seq: number }
  /**
   * The only frame that moves a session's epoch on a host (review r1 P1-1/P1-2, recovery-fix): the log is at `epoch`,
   * which began at `startSeq`; `tail` is every stored event `startSeq..lastSeq`, verbatim (at most 1000). Sent after a
   * recovery, after `hello` for each listed journal the log is ahead of, and on a `stale_epoch` batch. The host stops
   * the session's runner (or releases its own writer), cuts its journal at `startSeq`, appends `tail` and mirrors from
   * `lastSeq` under `epoch`. Idempotent: ignored at or above `epoch`. An epoch higher than the host's in `start`,
   * `deliver` or `api` is never adopted from those frames.
   */
  | { t: 'epoch'; sessionId: string; epoch: number; startSeq: number; lastSeq: number; tail: JournalEvent[] }
  /** A session's access list changed (or, after `welcome`, every session's: one frame per session). */
  | { t: 'access'; access: SessionAccess }
  /** API key `keyId` (or a ticket's key) was revoked: close its connections with 4001. */
  | { t: 'revoked'; keyId: string };

/** A journal on the host's disk, listed in `hello.journals` (every one): the gateway sends `epoch` where the log is ahead. */
export interface JournalReport {
  sessionId: string;
  /** 0: events with no epoch line yet (an adoption into a new file, torn before its commit record). */
  epoch: number;
  /** The epoch's first seq: `lastSeq < startSeq - 1 + tail.length` at the same epoch means the host lacks the log's events. */
  startSeq?: number;
  lastSeq: number;
}

/** Spliced into HostToGateway. */
export type HostToGatewayV4 =
  /** Answers `start`: the runner is claimed (or the session was already running). `error` when it could not start. */
  | { t: 'started'; id: string; sessionId: string; status: ApiSessionStatus; error?: ApiError }
  /** Answers `api`: the operation's result body (API "write results" or the read's body), or its error. */
  | { t: 'api-result'; id: string; result?: unknown; error?: ApiError }
  /**
   * The mirror: the next events of `sessionId` under `epoch`, in seq order, at least once. After a reconnect the host
   * resends from the last `journal-ack`. Flushed at once on turn ends, `ask.opened` and `session.status_changed`; else ≤ 100 ms.
   */
  | { t: 'journal'; sessionId: string; epoch: number; events: JournalEvent[] }
  /**
   * The latest `subagent.progress` values of the session's running subagents under `epoch` (never journaled; the
   * SessionLog merges them into reads). At most once a second per session, only when some changed; best effort, never resent.
   */
  | { t: 'subagent-progress'; sessionId: string; epoch: number; progress: SubagentProgress[] };

/** A `subagent.progress` delta's values (schema-events.ts). */
export interface SubagentProgress {
  subagentId: string;
  activity: string | null;
  toolCalls: number;
  tokens: number;
}

/** `welcome.wire`: the relay's edge key (the computer's key; today the previews key). */
export interface WireConfig {
  /** base64url, 32 bytes: verifies X-Wire-Auth (src/signed-header.ts). */
  key: string;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- relay ⇄ host (wire-link.ts)

/** Sent by the relay on $HOST_RUN/wire.sock, one JSON object per line. Calls carry `id`; the host answers `result`. */
export type WireToHost =
  | { t: 'hello'; version: string }
  /** Where the session's writer listens; `result: WhereResult`, or `session_not_found`. */
  | { t: 'where'; id: string; sessionId: string }
  /** Start the session's runner if it is suspended (the interactive screen's attach with `resume=1`); `result: { status }`. */
  | { t: 'resume'; id: string; sessionId: string; actor: ApiActor }
  /** `result: { terminalId, socket, channel? }`; bytes then flow on `socket` (a PTY, raw both ways). */
  | { t: 'terminal.open'; id: string; sessionId: string; member: string; cols: number; rows: number;
      command?: string; tty: boolean; term?: string }
  | { t: 'terminal.resize'; id: string; terminalId: string; cols: number; rows: number }
  | { t: 'terminal.eof'; id: string; terminalId: string }
  /** Also sent for every terminal of a closing connection (SIGHUP, SIGKILL after 5 s). */
  | { t: 'terminal.close'; id: string; terminalId: string }
  /**
   * `/files`: `result: { socket }`, a one-shot unix socket. `put`: the relay streams the archive into it and half-closes;
   * `get`: the host streams the archive (or one file with `file`) out of it. The outcome follows as `files.done`.
   */
  | { t: 'files.put'; id: string; sessionId: string; member: string; path: string; format: 'tar' | 'tar+gzip' | 'tar+zstd'; bytes?: number }
  | { t: 'files.get'; id: string; sessionId: string; member: string; path: string; file?: boolean }
  /** Counters for telemetry (host/telemetry.ts ships them with label `wire`). */
  | { t: 'telemetry'; name: string; fields: Record<string, number | string> };

export interface WhereResult {
  /** The writer's API socket. */
  socket: string;
  /** The socket's per-writer secret, sent first as `hello` (stands in for SO_PEERCRED, which node cannot read). */
  token: string;
  writer: 'runner' | 'host';
  epoch: number;
  /** The epoch's first seq (the journal's epoch line), for a relay that finds the epoch moved (`session.detached`). */
  epochStartSeq?: number;
}

/** Sent by the host to the relay. */
export type HostToWire =
  /** After `hello`, and again when any of it changes: the edge key and every session's access list. */
  | { t: 'welcome'; key: string | null; computer?: string; admins: string[]; access: SessionAccess[] }
  | { t: 'access'; access: SessionAccess }
  | { t: 'admins'; admins: string[] }
  | { t: 'revoked'; keyId: string }
  /** The session's writer changed (runner exited, started): ask `where` again and resubscribe after the last seq. */
  | { t: 'moved'; sessionId: string }
  | { t: 'terminal.exited'; terminalId: string; exitCode: number | null; signal: string | null }
  | { t: 'files.done'; id: string; result?: unknown; error?: ApiError }
  | { t: 'result'; id: string; result?: unknown; error?: ApiError };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- client ⇄ writer (<id>.api.sock)

/**
 * Sent to the session's writer by the relay (one socket per attachment) or the host's api-bridge. Several calls may be
 * in flight; the writer answers each with `result`, in the order it accepted them. At most one `subscribe` per socket.
 */
export type ApiClientFrame =
  /** First on every connection: the writer's token (WhereResult.token); anything else first, or a wrong token, closes it. */
  | { t: 'hello'; token: string }
  | { t: 'call'; id: string; method: string; params: unknown; actor: ApiActor; member: string;
      idempotencyKey?: string; requestId?: string }
  /**
   * Replay then live: events with seq > `after` (or the last `tailTurns` turns), then every new one. `result` is the
   * `sessions.attached` body less `sessionId`; events follow it. `deltas: false` drops deltas.
   */
  | { t: 'subscribe'; id: string; after?: number; tailTurns?: number; deltas: boolean; resume?: boolean }
  /** The client has everything up to `seq` (`sessions.ack`): the writer may drop it from this subscriber's queue. */
  | { t: 'ack'; seq: number };

export type ApiWriterFrame =
  | { t: 'result'; id: string; result?: unknown; error?: ApiError }
  | { t: 'event'; event: JournalEvent }
  | { t: 'delta'; delta: JournalDelta }
  /** The subscription ended: `too_far_behind` (its backlog), `moved` (the writer handed the journal on; ask `where`). */
  | { t: 'detached'; reason: 'too_far_behind' | 'moved' | 'access_lost' | 'epoch_changed'; logEpoch?: number; epochStartSeq?: number };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- host ⇄ runner (v4)

/** RunnerSpec.api and `claim.api`: what makes a runner its session's writer. Absent: no API (a pre-v4 host). */
/** Work 084: a cold-started runner's RunnerApi with its token, sent once it registers; RUNNER_SPEC carries `token: ''` (argv and the unit's environment are readable). */
export type HostToRunnerV4 = { t: 'api'; api: RunnerApi };

export interface RunnerApi {
  /** The public id (`cs_…`). */
  sessionId: string;
  /** The session's JSONL journal: the runner takes its flock before writing (src/api/journal.ts). */
  journal: string;
  /** Seeds the journal: seq continues at max(local tail, lastSeq) + 1; a higher epoch than the file's truncates past lastSeq. */
  epoch: number;
  lastSeq: number;
  /** Where to listen for ApiClientFrame (`<runner id>.api.sock`), and the token every connection must open with. */
  socket: string;
  token: string;
}

/** Delivery.api: a message that came through the API, not Slack; recorded already by the host's writer when `turnId` is set. */
export interface ApiDelivery {
  actor: ApiActor;
  member: string;
  ifBusy: 'queue' | 'steer' | 'interrupt';
  /** The turn the host's writer recorded (`message.received`, `turn.queued`) while no runner ran. */
  turnId?: string;
  idempotencyKey?: string;
  model?: string;
  effort?: string;
  mode?: string;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- Slack-bound narrowings

/** A person with a Slack identity: everyone the Slack gateway (src/gateway/) knows. */
export type SlackPerson = Person & { slackUserId: string };

/** A session bound to a Slack thread or channel: every session the Slack gateway creates. */
export type SlackSessionSpec = Omit<SessionSpec, 'kind' | 'channel' | 'owner'> & { kind: 'thread' | 'channel'; channel: string; owner: SlackPerson };

/** Whether a spec renders in Slack (SlackSurface) rather than nowhere (NullSurface). */
export const isSlackSpec = (spec: SessionSpec): spec is SessionSpec & SlackSessionSpec =>
  spec.kind !== 'api' && typeof spec.channel === 'string' && typeof spec.owner.slackUserId === 'string';
